feeds.title: The Beginner Photography Podcast
feeds.description: The Beginner Photography Podcast is a free weekly podcast hosted by professional photographer Raymond Hatfield who interviews world class photographers of all genres who share what they wish they knew when they got started so you can grow your creative photography skills faster! The podcast is brought to you by CloudSpot.io, the client gallery system that is always #EmpoweringPhotographers

feeds.title: Strobist Blog
feeds.description: From 2006 to 2021, Strobist was the world's most popular resource for photographers to learn to use their small flashes like a pro. David Hobby is an American photographer and author of the Strobist lighting blog, a site that promotes lighting techniques such as off-camera flash among photographic enthusiasts, often with an emphasis on the practical knowledge rather than the gear.
